Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Strong legislative framework: Act No. 025/2023 on personal data protection (APDPVP as regulator with sanctions), Law No. 027/2023 on cybersecurity and cybercrime, Law No. 025/2021 on electronic transactions. Data transfers abroad prohibited unless the destination country ensures adequate protection. Gabon ratified the AU Convention on Cybersecurity and Personal Data Protection (October 2024). Enforcement is still being established; APDPVP's adequacy country list has not yet been published.
